Thanks — reviewed and attached a redline (Novus_SOW_redline.docx). High-level legal assessment:

1) Exclusivity (market access carveout):
   - Customer asks for an 18-month exclusivity limited to "digital-banking" in EMEA. This is operationally and commercially high-risk — it restricts go-to-market for both Redwood and channel partners and is difficult to police.
   - Recommended compromise: allow a 6-month pilot exclusivity limited to the specific pilot account and use-case, with clear narrow definition of "digital-banking" (by NAICS/ISIC codes + named accounts) and a termination option on notice. Any longer term exclusivity must be exec-approved and tied to minimum committed ARR.

2) Pricing protection / MFN language:
   - The requested MFN is overly broad (applies to public pricing, partner promos, and resale channels). This would constrain promotional flexibility and our partner marketplace.
   - Recommended language: limit pricing protection to direct offers to comparable enterprise customers for the same scope and exclude partner marketplace listings and promotional pricing. Cap the protection to the pilot term and exclude tokenized/usage-based promos under $5k/month.

3) Discount level: procurement requests 40%; finance feedback (Laura) will determine whether a 30% capped discount tied to a minimum 12-month revenue commitment is feasible.

4) Audit/compliance: procurement has asked for additional SLAs and audit rights that need redlines. Noted in the attached.

Because both (1) and (2) are commercial carve-outs with potential competitive impact, Legal recommends exec review and signoff before we accept any exclusivity or broad MFN. If Sales wants to push a faster cadence, propose:
   - Offer: 30% discount now (capped to first 12 months) + a 6-month pilot exclusivity limited to named accounts + limited pricing protection (direct offers only).
   - Require: Deal desk/Finance to confirm revenue minimum and cap total contra (credits/discounts) before we deliver counters.

Marking this as an escalation for exec clearance.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Market access carveout + pricing protection — SOW and commercial ask

Appreciate the quick turnaround. My position: we can consider a constrained concession to close this quarter, subject to commercial protections. Specifically: 

- Approve up to 30% discount today (not 40%) if Novus commits to 12 months minimum and $420k minimum ARR for year one. Finance to confirm net revenue math and credit cap.
- Exclusivity: Approve a time-boxed 6-month pilot exclusivity limited to the specific named pilot account(s) and a narrow definition of "digital-banking". Any broader exclusivity (18 months or account-class based) needs my + Aditya's signoff and must be tied to revenue guarantees and a minimum guaranteed spend.
- MFN/pricing protection: Not acceptable as written. Approve a limited parity clause that applies only to direct public list pricing for enterprise deals with materially similar scope; exclude partner marketplace pricing, reseller promos, and non-enterprise promos. Add a financial cap on remediation tied to credits equal to the difference up to a maximum of 10% of the first-year committed revenue.

If Legal and Deal Desk can codify the above in the redline, I will greenlight sending a counter. If Novus refuses to accept these constraints and presses for the 18-month exclusivity + 40% + broad MFN, we should escalate to Aditya (revenue committee) for final signoff.

—Rishi
VP Sales Operations

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Market access carveout + pricing protection — SOW and commercial ask

Elena — thanks for the SOW and the clear ask. We want to get this over the line for you but need to be careful about long-term commercial carve-outs. Based on internal review, here's our counterproposal (attached updated SOW and pricing workbook):

- Discount: 30% off list for the first 12 months, contingent on a 12-month committed term and a minimum first-year ARR of $420,000.
- Exclusivity: We can offer a 6-month pilot exclusivity limited to the named pilot account(s) and a narrowly defined "digital-banking" use-case (see redline). Any extension beyond 6 months requires executive signoff and a minimum committed ARR threshold.
- Pricing protection: We will accept a limited parity commitment that applies only to direct, comparable enterprise offers; we will exclude partner marketplace pricing, reseller/promotional offers, and public trial programs. Remedies for any breach will be limited and capped (details in attached).

Please review and let us know if Novus can accept these guardrails. If you can confirm by 48 hours, we'll issue an updated DocuSign packet and prioritize the contract signature. 

Next steps: I have attached the redlined SOW and a pricing workbook. If you're aligned, procurement can sign and we will send DocuSign link (expires in 48 hours).

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
